summary: Well-executed, fully archived preregistered paired study that faithfully implemented the sealed shared_initial_generation contract and deterministic Batfish-style validator. The execution artifacts and reconciliations are consistent and reproducible. The principal scientific outcome is a degenerate null: every shared initial candidate was validator-clean (baseline = 200/200, guarded = 200/200), so no repairs were invoked and the preregistered secondary estimand is uncomputable. The manuscript correctly discusses why the contract produced this outcome and provides usable artifact pointers. No evidence of fabrication or undisclosed post-hoc changes was found, but several clarifications and small artifact-driven additions are required for publication readiness.
required_revisions: Include a concise validator-rule summary (table) in the manuscript showing rule IDs and human-readable descriptions for the validator harm-oracle implemented in the harness, and confirm that none of these rules fired (provide the artifact path and SHA256 for the rule-set). (Resolvable from the archived validator rule-set and scoring traces.)

Add a compact, explicit note in Methods quantifying the observed discordant-pair outcome (n_10=n_01=0) and explaining why the preregistered power calculation assumptions (discordant proportion ≈0.25) did not hold under the executed shared_initial_generation contract; report the post-hoc detectable effect given zero discordant pairs (i.e., clarify that the primary test became uninformative). (Resolvable from the archived contingency table and preregistration.)

Make explicit in the Abstract and Conclusion a single clear, unambiguous sentence that the preregistered secondary estimand (repair_success_rate >50%) is not estimable because repair was never invoked, and remove or tone any wording that could be read as implying repair efficacy was assessed. (Resolvable from archived per-episode repair_applied fields and scoring traces.)

Add an explicit pointer (path + SHA256) and one-sentence statement in Methods that contamination checks were run and confirm their (empty) result (analysis/contamination_summary.csv), so readers can verify the contamination claim without unpacking the full bundle. (Resolvable from analysis/contamination_summary.csv shown in artifact list.)

Supply a short, explicit caption or parenthetical in the figure/table that explains why the paired-bootstrap CI is degenerate ([0.0,0.0]) in this dataset (zero discordant pairs), referencing the archived paired contingency table. (Resolvable from analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv.)
optional_revisions: Where space permits, add a one-paragraph worked example (using archived per-task JSON) showing the sequence of fields in validator.validation_before → validation_after for one representative task to help practitioners interpret validator traces.

Discuss more explicitly in Limitations or Future Work the alternative preregistration choices (independent condition generation, larger repair budget) and include exact adapter config snippets (from execution/model_configuration.json) that a reader could use to run those follow-ups.

Consider adding a short diagram (1 small figure) that contrasts the causal questions answered by shared_initial_generation vs independent-generation designs; use archived accounting numbers to instantiate the example.]
